kitDescription: Anne: Miracle Fairy is a Wind rocket-launcher Supporter with a 60-second Burst II cooldown, built entirely around healing and team support. Every 3 normal attacks she heals all Supporter-class allies for a portion of attack damage over a 5-second window. While her HP stays above 90% she passively raises all allies' incoming healing, and when her magazine's last bullet lands while she is healthy, she cuts all enemies' incoming healing by a large amount for 10 seconds. Her burst heals all Attacker allies based on her own final max HP and grants them a large ATK buff for 10 seconds. Once per battle, the same burst can also revive one incapacitated Attacker ally at 99% HP.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs: all six kit lines are FAITHFUL or DOCUMENTED_GAP, and every load-bearing encoding (S1 hitCount:3 → Supporter-scoped heal event; burst burstCast → Attacker-scoped heal + atkPct 77.22/10s) converged across three independent derivations (S2b spec, S5 test, S6 override — 3/3 load-bearing agreement). The five S5 REDs are RECON_ERRORs, not divergences: the blind test chose controlComp, whose own B2 (crown, 40s CD) out-rotates anne (60s CD) for the single stage-2 slot so anne casts zero bursts — the exact hazard S2b's own notes pre-registered — and probe evidence (burstCasts by slug, casterAtkPct all from crown, helm saturating crown's recovery consumer at 161 frames ≈1127s coverage) mechanically explains every red, including the counter-intuitive flat WIDE_HEALS result. The driver's spec avoids the trap by fielding anne as sole B2 and adds non-vacuity gates, cast-frame identity pins, and working counterfactuals (all-allies retarget, fullBurstEnter re-key, line strips), so discrimination holds: each load-bearing assertion demonstrably fails under its named nearest-wrong model in the driver's fixture. The most dangerous misread (Incoming Healing ▼78.93% → damageTakenPct boss debuff) is absent from both override and event log and is explicitly documented against. For GO nothing must change. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: (1) the S1 tick granularity (driver ticks:5/intervalSec:1 vs blind ticks:1) is an unmeasured ⚑ either way and currently inert — if a Supporter-class recovery consumer ever lands in the roster, re-derive it from footage; (2) the convergence is same-family on S5/S6 (both claude-opus-5), so the shared heal-event/tandem convention itself — not any per-line encoding — is the thing no agent here independently questioned.
